name: pane-body-composer-gap-phone
description: On a phone the session composer floats over the transcript: the body runs to the pane's bottom edge so content scrolls under the chrome and leaves no in-flow band, while a footer-less pane keeps the phone's own inset and a flush body stays edge to edge.

mutation.declaration: panescaffold.module.css: (a) the phone block's `.footer` floating rule `position: absolute` set to `static`, (b) the `.body:not(:last-child)` / `.body:last-child` pair removed, (c) the phone block's `--pane-body-edge-inset` restatement removed, or (d) the floating footer given a solid `--composer-dock-scrim: var(--surface-0)`
mutation.note: At 390px, making the footer static left the session body 36px above the pane's bottom edge. Removing the selector pair left a 16px end band. Removing the phone token restatement gave the footer-less fixture 24px instead of 16px. The solid scrim failed the browser paint check while all geometry still passed.
